# AR Requirements Checklist: Explore University Agreements on a World Map

**Purpose**: Review whether the specification is complete, unambiguous, testable, and consistent with the constitution and the implementation plan
**Created**: 2026-09-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements specified for recognizing the predefined printed map itself, with codes and manual alignment excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements specified for keeping each marker on the same city while the phone moves around the sheet? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements specified for placing every partner at that partner's city, including two cities in one country? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Are overlap requirements specified so each partner stays independently selectable and is not folded into a single marker? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK005 Are requirements specified for an incapable phone: an explanation, the experience staying open, and no camera-only mode? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Are camera-denial requirements specified for an explanation, a retry, staying open, and continuing after a later grant without reinstalling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK007 Are offline requirements specified separately for markers and details, and for opening a website? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK008 Are the fields shown before selection and the fields shown after selection both specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 Are MVP exclusions documented for editing, search away from the map, live catalogs, directions, other maps, multiple agreements per partner, and a camera-only mode? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK010 Is "recognized" defined by what the person observes, rather than by a named tracking technique? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK011 Is "city in view" defined so a marker is required only when that city's position is on the visible part of the recognized map? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK012 Is "just enough" separation, or "next to its city," quantified with a maximum displacement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK013 Is "cannot keep markers attached" defined in observable terms, without a phone-model list in the specification? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK014 Is "try again" after camera denial specific enough to tell a first refusal from a refusal the system will not ask again? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK015 Is the action that dismisses partner details specified, or only the result of leaving those details? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK016 Is the moment the three-second recognition outcome starts specified? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK017 Do overlap requirements and the overlap success criterion both require every affected marker to stay separately visible and selectable, next to its city? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK018 Do incapable-phone requirements agree between the functional requirement and the success criterion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK019 Are explanation, stay-open, and recovery requirements consistent across camera denial, an unrecognized sheet, tracking loss, and an incapable phone? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-019, Constitution §IV]
- [x] CHK020 Do functional requirements avoid behavior that the assumptions list as out of scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK021 Do placement requirements stay user-observable while still matching the constitution rule that city placement can be judged without a camera? [Consistency, Constitution §III, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK022 Does the specification stay on one printed map and a prepared sample set, matching the constitution's MVP boundary? [Consistency, Constitution §V, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK023 Are plan-only choices, such as an image-quality score, a printed width, or a map projection, kept out of the product requirements unless the specification also states them? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK024 Are measurable outcomes defined for recognition time, city coverage, movement, overlap, details, first selection, failure trials, offline use, and incapable phones? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK025 Can "stays on the same city" be judged with an explicit tolerance, rather than only an observer's impression? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK026 Are the number of participants and the meaning of a correct first selection specified for the nine-out-of-ten outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK027 Are success-criterion identifiers unique and ordered so each outcome can be traced? [Traceability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are requirements defined for aiming at a different sheet, a photo, or a code instead of the predefined map? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for restoring the same cities after the map leaves the camera view and is recognized again? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for replacing open details when another marker is selected, and for returning to the map when details are dismissed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK031 Are website requirements defined for a usable address, a missing address, and a missing connection? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-018]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK032 Is the distinction specified between a map that is briefly out of frame but still followed, and a map that is lost? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK033 Are requirements defined for a logo that cannot be shown, including the named stand-in on both the marker and the details? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for countries with no partners, a tap where no marker exists, and a fast move that must not settle on the wrong city? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK035 Does the specification define what happens when a connection exists but the website cannot be reached? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK036 Does the specification define whether the same partner details are still available after the website has been opened? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK037 Are the assumptions of one host, English wording, one agreement per partner, and a city that can be indicated on the printed map written down rather than left implicit? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Is the prepared sample set, including logos, documented as available without a network, and is a downloaded catalog excluded? [Dependency, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes
